rules.name: Reaching
rules.description: Range ×1.3 per contribution.

rules.name: Widening
rules.description: Area ×1.2 per contribution.

rules.name: Focused
rules.description: Amplify ×1.12 per contribution.

rules.name: Piercing
rules.description: Extra native projectile penetration, limited to four pierces.

rules.name: Seeking
rules.description: Native projectiles steer toward an eligible target found at release.

rules.name: Forked
rules.description: Increase a native projectile fan; existing hit and rider budgets remain shared.

rules.name: Enduring
rules.description: Extend finite supported manifestations without independently extending event bindings.

rules.name: Patient
rules.description: Twenty extra charge ticks per contribution reduce mana payment.

rules.name: Hurried
rules.description: Shorter charge at a higher mana price.

rules.name: Delayed
rules.description: A visible cue precedes a two-second delayed release.

rules.name: Bleeding
rules.description: Positive primary damage opens one bounded wound.

rules.name: Shocking
rules.description: Add a small electrical rider after an eligible hit.

rules.name: Kindled
rules.description: Ignite a compatible damaged recipient.

rules.name: Chilling
rules.description: Cold contact leaves brief movement impairment.

rules.name: Freezing
rules.description: A sufficiently qualified cold impact builds a finite frozen state.

rules.name: Hindering
rules.description: Apply brief Slow after a qualifying outcome.

rules.name: Envenomed
rules.description: Add bounded poison to an eligible damaged recipient.

rules.name: Interrupting
rules.description: A qualifying impact interrupts one active supported channel.

rules.name: Marking
rules.description: Leave a visible tracking mark after a qualified contact.

rules.name: Repelling
rules.description: Drive a hit recipient away from the declared impact origin.

rules.name: Drawing
rules.description: Bring a qualified recipient toward an explicit anchor.

rules.name: Lifting
rules.description: Briefly lift a qualified subject.

rules.name: Unbalancing
rules.description: Apply a short physical stumble after contact.

rules.name: Echoing
rules.description: A supported direct outcome repeats at reduced strength.

rules.name: Mending
rules.description: Add finite regeneration after an eligible heal.

rules.name: Restoring
rules.description: Strengthen or replace a specifically eligible recovery outcome.

rules.name: Cleansing
rules.description: Couple eligible healing to a limited removal of harmful statuses.

rules.name: Purifying
rules.description: Remove explicitly selected harmful statuses after an eligible protective/healing result.

rules.name: Invigorating
rules.description: Healing briefly energizes a recipient.

rules.name: Quieting
rules.description: Suppress authored casting cues that own a sound.

rules.name: Veiled
rules.description: A compatible non-damaging utility cast grants brief invisibility.

rules.name: Excavating
rules.description: Increase the supported mining hardness threshold.

rules.name: Gathering
rules.description: Range ×1.2 per contribution.

rules.name: Shaping
rules.description: Range ×1.2 per contribution.

rules.name: Warded
rules.description: After successful entity protection, add an owned four-second ward with 2 charges and 1 base mitigation per hit.

rules.name: Absorbing
rules.description: After successful entity protection, add an owned four-second ward with 1 charges and 4 base mitigation per hit.

rules.name: Conjuring
rules.description: Increase explicitly authored construct or summon health.

rules.name: Revealing
rules.description: After detection or illumination, briefly outline up to eight nearby invisible creatures per cast without removing their invisibility.

rules.name: Anchored
rules.description: Freeze a moving field whose actual pulses query around its own position; target-locked and already stationary fields are incompatible.

rules.name: Reflecting
rules.description: Add a three-second protective halo that returns up to two incoming vanilla arrows or tridents; native spell deliveries are excluded.

rules.name: Frugal
rules.description: Amplify ×0.85 per contribution.

rules.name: Reckless
rules.description: Amplify ×1.15 per contribution.

rules.name: Votive
rules.description: Amplify ×1.12 per contribution.

rules.name: Greedy
rules.description: Amplify ×1.15 per contribution.

rules.name: Sacrificial
rules.description: Amplify ×1.1 per contribution.

rules.name: Famished
rules.description: Amplify ×1.1 per contribution.

rules.name: Bloodbound
rules.description: Amplify ×1.05 per contribution.

rules.name: Fasting
rules.description: Exchange a quarter of adjusted mana for one hunger point per five mana, rounded up.

rules.name: Exhausting
rules.description: Amplify ×1.05 per contribution.

rules.name: Charged
rules.description: Amplify ×1.15 per contribution.

rules.name: Vampiric
rules.description: One owned wound whose qualifying ticks return a bounded restoration portion to the caster.

rules.name: Hemorrhagic
rules.description: One finite wound reserves a calibrated portion for a normal-expiry terminal pulse.

rules.name: Tempestuous
rules.description: One charged windburst deals a calibrated electrical outcome and pushes eligible recipients from its center.

rules.name: Glacial
rules.description: One lingering cold field slows or builds freeze on qualified occupants.

rules.name: Stormbound
rules.description: One temporary electrical relay field joins a bounded set of selected contacts.

rules.name: Sustaining
rules.description: One recovery plan uses a declared hunger payment to support calibrated ongoing restoration.
